import.title: Import SmartStore Product Excel
import.description: Preview-validate a SmartStore product-list or bulk-edit XLSX first, then update products whose SKU matches the seller code/product number identifier and create the rest.
import.supportedFormats: Supported format: .xlsx only. Product-list exports use the first sheet with headers on row 1/data from row 2; bulk-edit files use the SmartStore bulk-edit sheet with headers on row 2/data from row 6.
import.supportedScope: Required fields: product name, sale price, and either product number or seller product code. Up to 500 rows; imports core fields, stock/status, shipping/free-shipping flags, product notice information, single/combination options, representative/additional image URLs, detail image URLs, and img tags in detail HTML. On commit, remote images are saved to store storage.
import.selectFileFirst: Select a SmartStore product Excel file first.
import.previewError: Failed to validate SmartStore product Excel.
import.commitSuccess: SmartStore product Excel applied to the store.

scopeDetails.identity: Identifier/SKU: seller product code is used first. If absent, the SmartStore product number is stored as naver-{product number}. Existing SKU matches are updated; unmatched rows create new products.
scopeDetails.pricing: Pricing/discounts: sales price becomes the base product price. An explicit sale-price column is used first; otherwise immediate discount value plus discount unit (%, KRW) is calculated into the store sale price.
scopeDetails.shipping: Shipping: free shipping types are imported as free-shipping products. Paid/conditional/quantity-tier/range-tier shipping, or a base shipping fee greater than zero, is imported as not free shipping.
scopeDetails.stockStatus: Stock/status: stock quantity is imported, and sales/display status determines active, sold-out, or hidden product state. Zero stock is treated as sold out.
scopeDetails.notice: Product notice information: manufacturer, manually entered origin, A/S phone, and A/S guide are copied into the store product notice fields. SmartStore product import currently stores the default notice type as teaware.
scopeDetails.options: Options: single and combination option exports import option names, option values, option price adjustments, option stock quantities, and option enabled/disabled state. Disabled/N/no/X options are skipped.
scopeDetails.images: Images: the representative image becomes the thumbnail, additional images become gallery images, and detail-image columns plus img tags inside detail HTML become detail images. Images are uploaded to the store S3/CloudFront storage while preserving the original bytes.
scopeDetails.limits: Limits: only .xlsx files are supported, and up to 500 product rows are processed per import. Preview only validates; clicking Apply to store performs the actual product and image writes.

shippingReturnsPage.title: Shipping, Exchange & Refund Policy
shippingReturnsPage.description: Detailed shipping, exchange/return, and refund standards beyond the product-detail summary.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.body:
Carrier: Orders are shipped through domestic parcel carriers such as CJ Logistics.
Shipping fee: Basic shipping fees are shown at checkout based on order and destination conditions.
Free shipping threshold: Shipping fees are waived when the order meets the free-shipping threshold.
Jeju/island/remote areas: Additional fees and delivery time may apply.
Delivery period: Orders are usually dispatched within 1–2 business days after payment and delivered within 2–5 business days after dispatch.
Dispatch cut-off: Orders paid before 2 PM on business days are prioritized for dispatch preparation.
Tracking: After dispatch, tracking is available from the order detail page or the tracking number in the shipment notice.

exchangeReturn.title: Exchange & Return Policy
exchangeReturn.body:
Request period: Requests may be submitted through customer support or My Page inquiries within 7 days after receipt.
Restrictions: For tea, food, and hygiene-sensitive products, change-of-mind exchanges/returns may be restricted if opened, used, packaging is damaged, components are missing, or product value is reduced.
Shipping fee responsibility: Ockhwadang covers shipping for defective or wrong items; customers cover round-trip shipping for change-of-mind returns.
How to request: Submit the order number, product name, reason, and supporting images when needed.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.body:
Refund approval: Refund eligibility is confirmed after the returned item is collected and inspected.
Processing period: After approval, refunds are processed to the original payment method within 3–7 business days.
Timing by payment method: Card and easy-payment cancellations may reflect at different times depending on card issuer and PG policies; international payments follow the payment provider schedule.
